answer: One concrete mechanism: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because pearl only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, copper is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any glacier approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
